Fraud Trends – First 6 Months of 2026

In the first six months of the year, Canadians reported approximately $351 million in losses to the CAFC.

Investment fraud - approximately $139.6 million reported lost

Spear phishing - approximately $57.7 million reported lost

In all of 2025, reported losses exceeded $68 million.

Bank investigator fraud - approximately $28.6 million reported lost

Reported losses were approximately $37.4 million in 2025.

Extortion - approximately $25.5 million reported lost

Losses exceeded the approximately $23 million reported during all of 2025.

Recovery fraud - approximately $13.7 million reported lost

Compared with approximately $25.9 million during all of 2025.
